name: commit-history
title: Commit History
description: A commit trail, one line per commit: a graph lane down the side, merges collapsed to one row that open their branch on a curved side lane, a pending commit that spins until it lands, and a commit's details inline under its row. Virtualized for 50,000+ commits; agents read and act on commits by name.
docs: `<CommitHistory aria-label commits branch branches onBranchChange />`. `commits` are newest first in `git log --topo-order` order, each `{ id, parents, message, date, author?, hash?, body?, tags?, stats?, status? }`; a string message turns backticked paths into `GitFileChip`s and git's merge subjects into `GitBranchChip`s, or pass segments. Merges start collapsed: a chevron, and a press, Enter, Right/Left or `expanded`/`defaultExpanded`/`onExpandedChange` open the merged commits on a side lane that curves back at the fork point. A press or Enter on any other commit opens its details under the row (author, the date in the page's language, the short hash with a copy button, files and +/- lines in success and destructive, the body); `detailsMode="multiple"` keeps several open, `details`/`defaultDetails`/`onDetailsChange` control them, and `onOpenCommit` takes the press instead, for apps that navigate to a commit. While details are open the other rows dim to `muted-foreground` (4.5:1); `focusMode` forces it on or off. `status: "pending"` spins a hollow ring and shows `labels.pending` in the link colour in place of the time; when it turns `"done"` the node grows into its check and the time and tags fade in. The header counts finished commits, or `count`. `tags` are `Badge`s with a `tone`; the time is `formatElapsed` ("26m") with the full date as its title, and every row's name reads "Merge invoice-pdf into main, 38 minutes ago, Release". One `useNow` clock every 30 s, or pass `now`. Rows virtualize with variable heights (open details are measured), the graph is laid out lazily from the top and an appended page costs only its rows; `hasMore`, `loadingMore` and `onLoadMore` load older commits as the end scrolls into view and from a Load more button. Give the history a bounded height (`className="max-h-[32rem]"` or a flex parent) so it scrolls itself. `findable` lets find in page reach commits scrolled out of view, by subject: rows move to UI SDK's virtualizer, whose findable layers are built once the page is idle after its first paint, and a match scrolls its row into view and highlights it in the row. It's off by default because it costs: on 50,000 commits about a frame on some held-arrow presses (p95 22–27 ms against 10 ms) and 10–40% on the first paint; with it the scroller is capped at `--commit-history-height` (40rem). Agents get `expandDetails`, `collapseDetails`, `expand`, `collapse`, `copyHash` (it returns the hash), `openCommit` (with `onOpenCommit`) and `selectBranch`, each taking a commit's id, hash or subject. `labels` overrides every text; `controller` from `createCommitHistoryController()` drives it from outside. `view="branches"` shows every active branch at a glance, a compact `git log --graph --all` (commits in `--all --topo-order`): `branches` takes `{ name, head, tone?, ahead?, behind?, updatedAt?, author? }`, the base (`branch`) keeps lane 0, each unmerged branch runs in its own lane from its merge-base in a stable chart colour (or its `tone`) and is labelled at its head with a pill (name, ↑ahead ↓behind, read in the row's name: "branch feature/x, 3 ahead, 12 behind"); merged branches stay folded under their merge. The header select lists the active branches under "All branches", each with a dot in its lane's colour (also in the trigger), its name, arrows for ahead and behind (a zero side left out, the words for screen readers) and its last update, and a search field filters them by name (`labels.searchBranches`, `labels.noBranches` when none match): choosing one, pressing its pill in the trail, or `focusBranch(name)` scrolls to its head and focuses it, and with `filterBranch` shows only the base and that branch; pressing the pill again shows them all. Past `maxLanes` (8 in this view) lanes collapse into "+N". Agents also get `focusBranch` and the read-only `listBranches()` (name, head, ahead, behind, updatedAt, state). 50,000 commits with 200 branches lay out in linear time.
